subject: Observability pilot: technical scope, SSO & onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@datadog.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability pilot: technical scope, SSO & onboarding checklist

Hi Soojin & team,

Thanks again for the intro — Datadog is excited to run a short pilot with Nimbus Retail and Redwood. Attached is a minimal SAML metadata file (scp-saml-metadata.xml) and a very small diagram showing the expected SSO flow for the pilot.

A few technical notes from our side to help the engineering kickoff:
- SP ACS URL (Datadog): https://app.datadoghq.com/saml/acs
- SP EntityID: https://app.datadoghq.com/saml/metadata
- Expected NameID: emailAddress (we can map other attributes if needed)
- SCIM provisioning endpoint: POST https://api.datadoghq.com/scim/v2/Users (Authorization: Bearer <token>)
- Session length suggestion: 8 hours for pilot users

Acceptance criteria we propose for a successful pilot:
1) SSO + SCIM provisioned test users (3 Nimbus test accounts)
2) Telemetry flow validated: 1000 events/min sustained during simulated peak for a 2-hour window
3) Key dashboards (ingestion, latency, error rates) onboarded and baseline established
4) Alert parity for three critical signals (checkout latency, inventory sync errors, payment gateway failures)

If you confirm the ACS/EntityIDs on your side, we can provision IdP entries and send temporary SCIM tokens.

We have a short pilot MoP (pilot-mop-v1.docx) that documents the schedule and success metrics; attaching that as well. Happy to join a technical sync this week.

Best,
Elena Morales
Partnerships, Datadog
Attachment: scp-saml-metadata.xml (application/xml)
Attachment: sso-infra-diagram.png (image/png)
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@datadog.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability pilot: technical scope, SSO & onboarding checklist

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and the metadata.

We reviewed the file and diagram. Two quick asks before we spin up IdP entries:
- Can you confirm SP entity IDs for EU-region customers as well (we may route a subset of telemetry via eu.datadog.com for Nimbus)?
- For SCIM tokens: please provide a token with a 7-day TTL and list the exact scopes required so our security team can approve.

On our side I'll attach a short diagram (sso-infra-diagram.png) showing how Redwood members and Nimbus pilot users map into Datadog roles. The pilot team will be me (eng lead), Marissa (alliances), and Vivek (partner sales).

One operational detail: we plan to run the telemetry load test from our staging cluster on Wed 24 Mar 14:00-16:00 PDT. Can Datadog confirm that ingestion throttling will not misclassify the synthetic load as an attack? We want accurate ingestion metrics.

I'll loop in Nimbus' SRE if/when we have the SCIM token. Proposed kickoff: Wed 24 Mar 11:00 PDT quick sync to validate SSO metadata — would that work for your engineering team?

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Technical Alliances, Redwood Inference
Attachment: pilot-mop-v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@datadog.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@beaconops.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability pilot: technical scope, SSO & onboarding checklist

Adding a couple of operational items and a proposed timeline from Redwood's side.

Proposed pilot timeline (2-week lightweight engagement):
- Week 0 (prep): exchange metadata, SCIM token, role mappings, security review
- Week 1 (tech-run): SSO + SCIM provisioning, ingest mapping, baseline dashboards
- Week 2 (validation): load run, alert tuning, acceptance handoff to Nimbus ops

Operational asks:
- Can BeaconOps provide a quick runbook for SCIM edge-cases (email collisions, group mapping)? Samir — any chance your team can draft a 1-pager on the common gotchas and a 2-hr runbook session for engineers during Week 0?
- Legal/security: if Datadog can confirm retention windows used during the pilot (rollup vs raw), we can sign off faster.

Elena — if we can lock Wed 11:00 PDT for the kickoff and Samir can support the Week 0 runbook, I think we can hit the Week 1 run. Vivek, please confirm pricing/credits for the pilot and whether we need a short SOW.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@beaconops.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@datadog.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability pilot: technical scope, SSO & onboarding checklist

Thanks Marissa — BeaconOps can run the SCIM/SSO workshop. Quick clarifications:
- SCIM: we recommend provisioning via SCIM PATCH for group assignments to avoid race conditions; we will include idempotency guidance in the runbook.
- Attribute mapping: we recommend mapping 'email' -> NameID and adding 'roles' as an optional array; Datadog should expose a roles claim if possible.
- Error handling: we will include a small script to reconcile failed SCIM creates (attachment: scim-reconcile.sh stub).

Availability: I can run the 2-hr session Tue 23 Mar 15:00 PDT or Wed 24 Mar 09:00 PDT. Which is better for the Datadog eng team?

Costs: for a 6-hour engagement (prep + runbook + session) BeaconOps will bill $2,200. If Redwood prefers, we can fold a one-off consulting credit into the pilot and invoice Nimbus directly.

Cheers,
Samir Patel
Principal Engineer, BeaconOps
Attachment: scim-reconcile.sh (text/x-sh)
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@datadog.com>, Samir Patel <samir@beaconops.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability pilot: technical scope, SSO & onboarding checklist

Great thread — quick commercial/ops summary from Redwood:
- Pilot credits: Redwood will cover Datadog ingestion costs up to $1,500 for the pilot window; if extra usage is required we'll triage case-by-case.
- BeaconOps: approve the $2,200 consulting engagement; Redwood will pay BeaconOps and invoice Nimbus for pass-through as needed.
- SOW: Marissa, please generate a 1-page SOW covering dates, credits, and acceptance criteria (pulling from the pilot-mop-v1).
- Kickoff: locked for Wed 24 Mar 11:00 PDT (Soojin to send the invite) — agenda: 20m SSO/SCIM verification, 30m ingest mapping, 10m Q&A.

Action items:
1) Soojin: send calendar invite + dial-in + temporary SCIM token request to Datadog.
2) Elena: provide EU region entityIDs and SCIM token scope.
3) Samir: confirm runbook slot (we prefer Tue 23 Mar 15:00 PDT if Datadog can make it).
4) Marissa: drop 1-pg SOW into the linked drive and tag legal.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
